Practice

What is Liv 2.

0?

It is Thermacell's new Wi-Fi-connected mosquito protection system for outdoor spaces.

What substance does the system use to help keep insects away?

It uses metofluthrin, which is a chemical repellent.

How large an area can Liv 2.

0 protect?

Thermacell says it can cover up to 900 square feet.

What is different about the way Liv 2.

0 is set up?

It requires professional installation instead of simple home setup.

Why might some buyers think carefully before purchasing it?

They may like the larger coverage, but the starting price is much higher than the original system.
